_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: New chats keep output_iframe's off for output_html, once. To "store O" is to eval localStorage.setItem("shelley.toolOverrides", JSON.stringify(O)) for the object O; to "store O fresh" is to do that and also eval localStorage.removeItem("shelley.toolOverrides.outputHtml"). "The tools text" is ".model-picker-section-text" inside the panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools". To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". The screen is a 1280x800 desktop window. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match, "whose name contains X" a substring one. "The panel" is ".model-picker-panel". To "open the knob": click ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; the panel should be visible. To "edit tools": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools"; the panel should be hidden. "The pills" are data-testid "model-picker-profiles"; "the profile X" is the radio (role "radio") named X inside them. To "edit profiles": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the pills. "The section" is data-testid "model-picker-auto-compaction"; "the section's X" is the radio named X inside it, and "the nudge" is its select (role "combobox"). "The dialog" is the element with role "dialog". "The X tool" is the dialog's radiogroup with aria-label X ('[role=radiogroup][aria-label="X"]'). "The auto compaction row" is the dialog's data-testid "auto-compaction". To "apply": click the dialog's button whose name contains "Apply to this conversation"; the dialog should be hidden. "The markers" are the data-testid "message-modelchange" elements. "Changed" is the panel's data-testid "model-picker-profile-changed". To "save as new" a name N: click changed's button whose name contains "Save as new…", fill changed's textbox named "New profile name" with N and press Enter in it. A "row" X is the dialog's data-testid "profile-row" containing the text X. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. The composer first takes on its profile's settings: eval localStorage.getItem("shelley.profileApplied") until it returns "Default". 2. Store {"output_iframe":"off"} fresh. Reload the page and open the model picker: the tools text should contain "output_html". 3. Later, output_html back at its default stays there: store {"output_iframe":"off"}, not fresh. Reload the page and open the model picker: the tools text should have exactly the text "All at their defaults".
